message.content:
The most prominent “world‑level” event in 2015 was the **Candidates Tournament** that decided who would challenge Magnus Carlsen for the World Chess Championship.  
**Sergey Karjakin** won that tournament, earning the right to play Carlsen in the 2016 title match.

(If you were thinking of another event—e.g., the World Rapid or Blitz Championships—those were also won by Magnus Carlsen in 2015.)
